description: Kuruwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha - The Roads and Thoroughfares Considered to be Owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Kuruwalagaswewa
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of roads and thoroughfares as owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Karuwalagaswewa local government authority. It includes detailed schedules of specific roads with their coordinates, lengths, and widths, which falls under land registrations and property ownership determinations. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
